name: NVIDIA ConnectX-7 NDR 400G Adapters Datasheet
notes: ConnectX-7 NDR 400Gb/s InfiniBand HCA datasheet. States 400Gb/s total bandwidth, NDR 400Gb/s, HDR 200Gb/s, EDR 100Gb/s speeds, 1/2/4 ports, PCIe Gen5 x32, 330-370M messages/sec RDMA, SHARP support, collective operations offload, GPUDirect RDMA/Storage, adaptive routing, enhanced congestion control.
